connector.name: Polymarket Wallet Intelligence
connector.registryDescription: Classify Polymarket wallets as human or bot, score their trading edge, read open positions.
connector.summary: Hosted at polymarket-intel-production.up.railway.app over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the Python package polymarket-intel-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the aemery13 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
